verdict.rationale: Whether an email provider uses customer data to train AI models is a fair privacy-posture question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents an AI-training policy, a no-training commitment, or an opt-out control. One user praising Fastmail as up front about data handling is too general to count as support for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
